package.name: clearsky_os_effectors
package.description: Simulation-safe non-kinetic effector catalog and selection policy for ClearSky OS C-UAS. Models defensive options (HPM-style denial, cognitive jamming, GNSS/link spoofing, authorized control-link takeover, multi-sensor deception) and publishes human-gated effector intent for downstream cognitive review. All actuation is monitor-only by default.
